name: A Young White Stork's Begging Call
description:
Begging sound of a young white stork (ciconia ciconia).

White storks breed across Europe, North Africa, and Western Asia, and while many migrate to Sub-Saharan Africa, an increasing number now spend the winter in Spain and Portugal.

Recorded by me with a cellphone (Redmi Note 14 Pro 5G) from very close range during my volunteer work at a wildlife rescue and raptor center. Unedited except for trimming at the beginning and end. Location left private to respect the center's focus on rescue work.

name: city park Zaltbommel Netherlands 1135 am 250203_0991
description:
Winter morning in the city park in Zaltbommel, the Netherlands.
About the picture It’s a clear morning in the Stadswallenpark of Zaltbommel. You’re standing with your back to the imposing medieval city wall. In front of you lies the gently sloping park, with the Singelgracht shimmering in the sunlight. Bare trees cast long shadows across the grass. Behind you is the town, quiet behind the high walls; the traffic you hear comes from outside the city center.
About the recordings location: The microphones are positioned just behind the tall medieval city walls, overlooking the park. Behind me lies the city center, barely audible due to the high walls. You can hear traffic, but it comes from outside the city center. In front of me is the Singelgracht — a city moat that encircles the town. More recordings here today / More around here trough the years About the Stadswallenpark (city wall park) history Zaltbommel developed into a walled city with moats from the 14th century onward. In the 16th and 17th centuries, it became a strategic fortress town, reinforced with bastions, ramparts, and an outer moat. After losing its military function in the 19th century, the area was transformed into a public city park in English landscape style. In the 20th century, the park fell into neglect, but between 2017 and 2025 it was restored based on the original 1834 design. Today, the Stadswallenpark offers a unique blend of history, nature, and tranquility.
